  "description": "- Be responsible for the daily management, work allocation and performance evaluation of the pre-sales support team to ensure its efficient operation.\n- Guide and supervise team members in performing pre-sales support tasks, including customer consultation, sales opportunity discovery, product recommendation and assistance with online purchase.\n- Assist in formulating and optimizing pre-sales support processes and service standards to enhance customer satisfaction and sales conversion rates.\n- Regularly organize team training to improve members' capabilities in product knowledge, communication skills and service awareness.\n- Closely collaborate with sales, technical and other departments to facilitate the smooth conversion of customer sales inquiries and subsequent follow-ups.\n- Monitor teamwork data, conduct analysis and reporting, and propose improvement suggestions for implementation.\n- Maintain team morale in high-pressure environments and motivate members to achieve both individual and team performance goals",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:\n3 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  Đại Học trở lên  Diễn đạt trôi chảy\n\nCandidate Requirements\n- **At least 3 years of management experience in a Pre Sales Lead, or Sales or Telesales Lead**\n- Proven sales track record, preferably in **B2C or D2C** environments, with demonstrated ability to coach, motivate, and drive a high-performing team.\n- **Fluent in English**.\n- Experience supporting or selling to English speaking markets, particularly within the APAC region.\n- Experience in the Tech industry or SaaS/online platforms is preferred.\n- Strong data sensitivity, with the ability to identify performance gaps through data analysis and implement effective improvement actions.\n- Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.\n- Proven ability to perform under pressure, stay composed in high volume or fast changing environments, and lead the team to consistently high levels of performance.\n\nKiến thức ngành\nIT - Phần mềm"
